answer: Sybil resistance here comes from a proof-of-work stake sunk before an identity can speak: each new agent wallet must burn real compute to earn its first mined balance, and that balance locks further with each honest attestation. A swarm of fakes cannot be spun up for free, because every body needs its own independent burn. Like water polishing a prism under an ocean swell, cost scales linearly with headcount while the per-epoch reward stays capped, so a thousand-identity attack pays a thousand times the honest price and gains nothing extra; abandoned sybils become stranded shale.
